notes: Long-only strategy version of the WaveTrend Oscillator (LazyBear concept) plus RSI framing. Entry on WT1/WT2 crossover (optionally gated to only 'strong' crosses beyond oversold/overbought bounds), exit on the opposite crossover (same strong/all toggle independently for each side). Self-contained calculation, no request.security, no session logic. Author's doc: 'Simulate the buy/sell dots across any asset and timeframe.' 91 lines, ~8 params.
